markets.rules_secondary:
This market uses Sleeper's total full-PPR fantasy points for Week 1 of the 2026 Pro Football regular season, including overtime. It ranks all TEs, including eligible players without a listed market. Player-group membership is determined by Sleeper at expiration. If a player does not play in the week they will be considered to have scored 0 points.

Dead-heat rules apply in the event that two or more players are tied at the final qualifying position.

If a tie occurs at the cutoff position, each tied player's contract shall settle at 1/N, where N is the total number of players tied for the remaining qualifying position(s).

Example: In a market for the top 10 fantasy quarterbacks, if two quarterbacks are tied for 10th place, each tied player's contract will settle at $0.50.

Please read the scoring format below. All values are fantasy points under Sleeper’s default full-PPR scoring.

Passing, rushing, and receiving

Passing yards: +0.04 per yard (+1 per 25 yards).
Passing touchdown: +4.
Interception thrown: −1.
Passing two-point conversion: +2.
Rushing yards: +0.1 per yard (+1 per 10 yards).
Rushing touchdown: +6.
Rushing two-point conversion: +2.
Reception: +1.
Receiving yards: +0.1 per yard (+1 per 10 yards).
Receiving touchdown: +6.
Receiving two-point conversion: +2.

Kicking

Field goal made, 0–39 yards: +3.
Field goal made, 40–49 yards: +4.
Field goal made, 50–59 yards: +5.
Field goal made, 60+ yards: +6.
Extra point made: +1.
Field goal missed: −1.
Extra point missed: −1.

Defense and special teams (D/ST)

Defensive touchdown: +6.
Sack: +1.
Interception made: +2.
Defensive fumble recovery: +2.
Forced fumble: +1.
Safety: +2.
Blocked kick: +2.
Special-teams touchdown: +6.
Special-teams forced fumble: +1.
Special-teams fumble recovery: +1.

D/ST points allowed per game

0 points allowed: +10.
1–6 points allowed: +7.
7–13 points allowed: +4.
14–20 points allowed: +1.
21–27 points allowed: 0.
28–34 points allowed: −1.
35+ points allowed: −4.

Individual-player special teams and fumbles
Special-teams touchdown: +6.
Fumble: 0.
Fumble lost: −2.
Fumble-recovery touchdown: +6.

markets.rules_primary: If Jalen Hurts finishes within the top 5 highest in total full-PPR fantasy points for all QBs in Week 1 of the 2026 Pro Football regular season, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
This market uses Sleeper's total full-PPR fantasy points for Week 1 of the 2026 Pro Football regular season, including overtime. It ranks all QBs, including eligible players without a listed market. Player-group membership is determined by Sleeper at expiration. If a player does not play in the week they will be considered to have scored 0 points.

Dead-heat rules apply in the event that two or more players are tied at the final qualifying position.

If a tie occurs at the cutoff position, each tied player's contract shall settle at 1/N, where N is the total number of players tied for the remaining qualifying position(s).

Example: In a market for the top 10 fantasy quarterbacks, if two quarterbacks are tied for 10th place, each tied player's contract will settle at $0.50.

Please read the scoring format below. All values are fantasy points under Sleeper’s default full-PPR scoring.

Passing, rushing, and receiving

Passing yards: +0.04 per yard (+1 per 25 yards).
Passing touchdown: +4.
Interception thrown: −1.
Passing two-point conversion: +2.
Rushing yards: +0.1 per yard (+1 per 10 yards).
Rushing touchdown: +6.
Rushing two-point conversion: +2.
Reception: +1.
Receiving yards: +0.1 per yard (+1 per 10 yards).
Receiving touchdown: +6.
Receiving two-point conversion: +2.

Kicking

Field goal made, 0–39 yards: +3.
Field goal made, 40–49 yards: +4.
Field goal made, 50–59 yards: +5.
Field goal made, 60+ yards: +6.
Extra point made: +1.
Field goal missed: −1.
Extra point missed: −1.

Defense and special teams (D/ST)

Defensive touchdown: +6.
Sack: +1.
Interception made: +2.
Defensive fumble recovery: +2.
Forced fumble: +1.
Safety: +2.
Blocked kick: +2.
Special-teams touchdown: +6.
Special-teams forced fumble: +1.
Special-teams fumble recovery: +1.

D/ST points allowed per game

0 points allowed: +10.
1–6 points allowed: +7.
7–13 points allowed: +4.
14–20 points allowed: +1.
21–27 points allowed: 0.
28–34 points allowed: −1.
35+ points allowed: −4.

Individual-player special teams and fumbles
Special-teams touchdown: +6.
Fumble: 0.
Fumble lost: −2.
Fumble-recovery touchdown: +6.
